checked_routes.result: The official game landing page confirms Disco Elysium and ZA/UM context but does not provide exact campaign character names.

ZA/UM Studio Store names a Horrific Necktie product and describes a Disco Elysium print tie. This establishes licensed merchandise wording, not that the campaign tag is the in-game character identity; no relation is asserted.
The official accessories catalog exposes the Horrific Necktie listing but does not map Harry Du Bois, Jean Vicquemare, or Kim Kitsuragi to a character roster.

notes: Official game and store routes were checked. The official store product label alone is insufficient to establish the in-game character identity for horrific_necktie, and no exact character roster mapping was established for the other three tags. This is partial research accounting, not negative evidence or campaign exhaustion.
